# Repository guidance for GitHub Copilot
Follow root AGENTS.md and use .agents/skills/*/SKILL.md only when relevant to the current task. This is Student Creators Platform, not school-learning-platform or an LMS. Preserve code, test exact behavior, keep real student IDs/payment credentials out of the repository, respect server-side paid access and creator restrictions, and never infer passing tests/deployments from docs. Research branch: researches-and-tasks. See docs/researches-and-tasks/ for flows, goals, tools, roles and issue acceptance evidence. No one is assigned a volunteer role without consent.
